My inclination is to have Voat follow this standard:

  • If the speech is allowed in any part of the free world, then that speech gets to stay.
  • Allow mods to mark a post as off-topic, but not remove it.
  • A mod's mark and ban history are public.
  • Mod's are expected to give a reason for marking a post and banning a user.
  • A ban or mark itself can be voted on by users as being reasonable or questionable.

Some consequences of this:

  • Things like child pornography will not be allowed because they are simply illegal.
  • Hate speech, while distasteful, doesn't get removed. Even on Reddit hate speech is quickly down voted.

Preventing Mods from burying content:

  • If a mod doesn't like a post, they can mark it, but it still shows up in the sub.
  • If a marked post is truly off topic, then frequenters can downvote the post accordingly and the post gets pushed off the sub's front page.
  • If a marked post is actually on topic, then it gets upvoted and stays on the sub's front page.

Mod accountability:

  • The community can hold a vote of no confidence in a mod and have the user de-modded.
